1.consolidated_definition: Palma de hasta 10 m de altura, con tronco solitario, espinoso, hojas pinnadas y pequeñas flores amarillas; sus hojas se utilizan para tejer sombreros. Arecaceae; Aiphanes acanthophylla.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Palm tree up to 10 m in height, with solitary, spiny trunk, pinnate leaves and small yellow flowers; its leaves are used for weaving hats. Arecaceae; Aiphanes acanthophylla.

2.consolidated_definition: En la industria cafetera, grano de café de color muy oscuro por haberse cosechado estando aún verde.
2.en_consolidated_definition: In the coffee industry, a dark-colored coffee bean that has been harvested while still green.
